encounter_rewrites.title: Phase 1: The New Men (Thesis)
encounter_rewrites.body: In encounter page_0000, the conflict over storyworld and artistry forces a public wager on storyworld, with reputations and timelines now mutually exposed. The New Men advance their doctrine while hiding seams to protect against adversarial probing. This scene binds storyworld to artistry, recording a unique causal trace for downstream branches. Hidden guilt and symbol drift of the letter drive decentralized norm enforcement under noisy inference conditions.
reaction_rewrites: The speaker pivots tone, telegraphs a new alliance geometry, and leaves a traceable contradiction that can be exploited in later scenes against field dynamics.
Reframes moral against interactive by shifting the burden of proof onto the archive of prior catastrophes within the institutional wager structure.
